gaps.reason: No continuous scanned skin mesh. Regional surface patches are excluded; no new skin envelope is invented.

membershipPolicy: Complete source meshes, no regional cuts. Back includes bilateral shoulder girdle, ribs and occipital attachment context. Shoulder/back structures have shared canonical identities, independently recorded laterality. Explicit collection omissions are resolved by source names and bounds.

units: meters in GLB; millimeters at runtime
processing: Complete source anatomy without region cuts or reflection
Bone/cartilage and muscle/tendon source material separation
Bone/muscle material seams capped; connective sheets retain source borders
Curves converted with source bevel depth and control-point radii
Triangle budgets: 8000 per bone/muscle, 12000 per other source object
limitations: No scanned skin mesh or substitute envelope
Some named source muscles and nerves are absent; see gaps
Spinal cord is recorded in data only and excluded from all assets and controls
Source muscle action material labels and attachment patches provide limited metadata, not a complete clinical reference
Source meshes and sheets are static simplified anatomy, without biomechanics

attachmentValidation.scope: Reviewed bone families only; illustrative focus footprints, not exhaustive clinical attachments
